answer.explanation: The live inline policy app-policy on the Thumbnailer execution role contains an extra statement (Sid SilentDriftExtra) allowing s3:ListAllMyBuckets on Resource "*". The IaC template for ThumbnailerRole only grants s3:GetObject on the input bucket and s3:PutObject on the output bucket, so this is drift from the intended state. The statement is over-broad and silent: no errors, denials or timeouts appear in the window logs, and the live memory, timeout and environment settings match the template. The other three roles (CrudApi, Uploader, Compression) match the template. The Thumbnailer configuration was last modified at 02:16:07Z, before the window, so the time of the IAM change is not confirmed.
